content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** The licence grant (p0030) fails both LICENSE fallback elements — it runs to Licensee only, with access restricted to Licensee's own employees (p0045) and no transfer of licence rights without consent (p0042, p0149), while Article XX (p0134) auto-terminates the Agreement and all licences on any Change of Control absent Licensor consent that may be withheld on broad grounds.

**Redline (fallback level, two surgical replacements):**
1. p0030 — grant extended to Licensee "and, upon written notice to Licensor, its Affiliates and their personnel (each deemed an employee of Licensee for purposes of the restrictions herein)", so the retained third-party/employee-only restrictions do not swallow the new coverage.
2. p0134 — the change-of-control auto-termination and consent machinery is replaced with continuation and transfer to our successor in a merger or acquisition without Licensor's approval; the Change of Control definition (relied on by p0149) is preserved intact.

Preferred-only items (perpetual/irrevocable paid-up licence, contractors, termination only for uncured material breach) were noted but not pursued at the selected fallback target.
